**Rationale:** The patient is a 23-year-old male recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone 2 months ago. He reports significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms, which suggests therapeutic efficacy of the antipsychotic. The timing (2 months post-initiation) aligns with the typical latency period for such side effects.
